card.name: Words after "the" or "as" in comparisons
card.fires_on: The word "possibility" or "possible" right after "the" in a warning clause, as in "the possibility of ... should be considered". Also "much" or "about" in similar paired constructions.

modes.label: the possibility of
modes.description: "possibility" or "possible" right after "the" in a precaution or overdose sentence.
modes.example: As with the management of any overdose, the<< possibility>> of multiple drug ingestion should be considered.

modes.label: as much / and about
modes.description: A quantity or comparison word in an "as ... as" or contrast construction in general text.
modes.example: to ensure that as<< much>> energy as possible goes into fuel production.

card.plain: It marks the word "possibility" in phrases like "the possibility of" that open a caution in drug labels.
